notes.title: v1.74 update
notes.content:
-New 'Mirror' game mode (all players have the same spells)
-Fixed exploits with Mana Sacrifice
-Creatures summoned after Teleport have 50% of APs
-Undead Ibis re-balanced

notes.title: v1.69 update
notes.content:
v1.69 update of The Last Warlock is now live: 

Multiplayer games can now have an optional Warlock Designer mode. Customize your Warlocks abilities and spells to create unique strategies!

Also added to multiplayer is the 'Warlock Powers' option that can be any range from -2 to +4 (where zero is 'normal'). This will affect the number of coins allocated to all players, so you can create games with abnormally powerful Warlocks if you choose.

notes.title: v1.63 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New multiplayer map
[*] New creature: Golem (4 in 1)
    - Tree Golems can possess other trees, and are good with wooden weapons (though vulnerable to axes).
    - Rock Golems are naturally good at throwing rocks, and can summon a wall of rock.
    - Fire Golems will multiply, just like fire!
    - Blob Golems are the strangest of all, and come with a throwable blob!
[*] U.I. improvements.
[*] General bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.62 Update

notes.title: v1.60 Update
notes.content:
-Added randomly spawning Leprechauns to multiplayer mode.
-Better handling of out-of-sync games.
-Changes to handicap calculations.
-Option to opt out of handicap system.
-General bug fixes.
-Improved support for Windows touch screen devices.

notes.title: Multiplayer update!
notes.content:
An update to the game just went live that adds and tweaks some multiplayer features:
[list]
[*] Six new spells added to the multiplayer modes, including a new creature named 'The Watcher'.
[*] More crafting items added to the maps.
[*] Subvert now has a % chance of success based on the strength and health of the target creature.
[*] Bows will wear and eventually be destroyed with use.
[*] Experimental handicap system added to make the game easier for new players to compete against veterans.
[*] Fix to creatures sometimes not defending their Warlock.
[/list]

If you encounter a problem, please post to the forum or email support@sonicsloth.com and I'll get right on it!
